description: This file defines the DocProps class that manages writing document properties and metadata (core, custom, application properties) to XML files within a PHPExcel spreadsheet writer for XLSX files.

classes.name: DocProps
classes.description: Handles writing of document properties (app, core, custom metadata) to XML files for XLSX worksheets.

methods.name: writeDocPropsApp
methods.description: Generates the application properties XML (app.xml) for the spreadsheet, including sheet count, titles, company, manager, and version info.

methods.name: writeDocPropsCore
methods.description: Generates the core properties XML (core.xml) for the spreadsheet, including author, last modified, title, description, subject, keywords, category, and timestamps.

methods.name: writeDocPropsCustom
methods.description: Generates the custom properties XML for the spreadsheet, including custom key-value pairs, with appropriate data type handling.
